methodology: Same box, same oha oha 1.16.0, same contract + routes + levels as @zmdb/web. Per route for 8s, keep-alive disabled, latency-corrected. Each cell run 3x after a discarded warmup and reduced to the MEDIAN run; requests_per_s_min/max give the spread. Each peer contract-verified before load. CORE USAGE IS NOT NORMALIZED: Go peers use GOMAXPROCS (all 16 cores) and Rust peers num_cpus by default, while node/bun/deno peers use one core unless their app clusters — so cross-runtime rows are not per-core comparable.
